```artifact
Feature: User Login and Speciality Management

  Scenario: Valid User Login
    Given the user "admin" with password "password123" exists
    When the user logs in with username "admin" and password "password123"
    Then the user is redirected to the Virtual Clinic Main Menu

  Scenario: Invalid User Login
    Given the user "invalid" with password "invalid" exists
    When the user logs in with username "invalid" and password "invalid"
    Then the system displays an error message "Invalid username or password"

  Scenario: Empty Username Login
    Given the user "admin" with password "password123" exists
    When the user logs in with username "" and password "password123"
    Then the system displays an error message "Username cannot be empty"

  Scenario: Overly Long Username Login
    Given the user "admin" with password "password123" exists
    When the user logs in with username "a".repeat(256) and password "password123"
    Then the system displays an error message "Username is too long"

  Scenario: Empty Password Login
    Given the user "admin" with password "password123" exists
    When the user logs in with username "admin" and password ""
    Then the system displays an error message "Password cannot be empty"

  Scenario: Overly Long Password Login
    Given the user "admin" with password "password123" exists
    When the user logs in with username "admin" and password "a".repeat(256)
    Then the system displays an error message "Password is too long"

  Scenario: Add Speciality
    Given the administrator exists
    When the administrator adds a speciality with id "SP001", name "Cardiology", and description "Heart-related diseases"
    Then the speciality is added successfully

  Scenario: Edit Speciality
    Given the speciality "SP001" with name "Cardiology" and description "Heart-related diseases" exists
    When the administrator edits the speciality with id "SP001", name "Cardiology Updated", and description "Heart-related diseases Updated"
    Then the speciality is updated successfully

  Scenario: Delete Speciality
    Given the speciality "SP001" with name "Cardiology" and description "Heart-related diseases" exists
    When the administrator deletes the speciality with id "SP001"
    Then the speciality is deleted successfully

  Scenario: Create User
    Given the administrator exists
    When the administrator creates a user with id "U001", username "user1", and password "password1"
    Then the user is created successfully

  Scenario: Maintain Speciality
    Given the administrator exists
    When the administrator maintains specialities
    Then the speciality list is displayed

  Scenario: Administrator System Administrator Screens
    Given the administrator exists
    When the administrator accesses the system administrator screens
    Then the system administrator screens are displayed

  Scenario: Set-up Users/ Passwords
    Given the administrator exists
    When the administrator sets up users and passwords
    Then the users and passwords are set up successfully

  Scenario: Set-up Control File
    Given the administrator exists
    When the administrator sets up the control file
    Then the control file is set up successfully

  Scenario: Create Appointment File
    Given the administrator exists
    When the administrator creates the appointment file
    Then the appointment file is created successfully

  Scenario: View/ Print Invoice
    Given the administrator exists
    When the administrator views and prints the invoice
    Then the invoice is displayed and printed successfully

  Scenario: Back-ups
    Given the administrator exists
    When the administrator backs up the system
    Then the system is backed up successfully

  Scenario: Archive Patient Profiles
    Given the administrator exists
    When the administrator archives patient profiles
    Then the patient profiles are archived successfully
```
